method: Rigify reference (blender/blender scripts/addons_core/rigify/metarigs/human.py, 22195 stars, GPL-2.0) for axial heights (crown-anchored scale 0.96133 = 1.9029/1.9796) + sacrum depth; fitted to this mesh via in-viewport GLB cross-section measurement (quantized uint16 decode + node scale/translation + root-local shift). Arm heights kept from estimator (validated vs anthropometry: elbow 65.8%, wrist 53.8% of stature; Rigify arm heights are A-pose artifacts and do not transfer). Lateral values from measured tube centers (deltoid, wrist, hand, neck, head). Interior joints, never on skin.
reapply: After estimate_rig_markers on this model: set_transform each marker above via {"type":"set_transform","targetName":"Marker_<id>","position":[...]} in any batch size. Then set_transform each marker scale [0.7,0.7,0.7] so the 5 cm spheres read inside the joint volumes (positions stay Rigify-exact; rig building uses positions only). Both sides explicit and symmetric; no mirror_markers needed.
centerMethod: Volumetric centering vs the original 691k-tri mesh: per axis, median of 5 DoubleSide raycast pair-midpoints (12mm sample square), both-walls-required, width caps per region (limb 160mm, column 500mm), 4mm deadband, 60mm sanity cap, Y never touched. Skin markers untouched: headTop (crown), leftFoot/rightFoot (toe tips). Column X kept on measured midline (hair mass drags lateral midpoints). Leg X pairs (knee/ankle/midfoot) rejected: rays straddle both legs — kept measured tube positions.
